join hortbot 999 foobar 1
join hortbot 999 user2 2


handle hortbot foobar/1 user2/2 :!list add mylist
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 user2/2 access=subscriber :!list add mylist
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list add mylist
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List 'mylist' added, restricted to subscribers and above.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist add
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !mylist add <item>


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist get what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !mylist get <index>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist get 0
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Index out of range.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist get 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] The list is empty.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist add Something
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "Something" has been added to the list as item #1.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist add Something
send hortbot #foobar [HB] The list already contains that item.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist get 0
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Index out of range.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist get -1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Index out of range.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist get 0
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Index out of range.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist get 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Something

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist get 2
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Index out of range.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist add Other thing
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "Other thing" has been added to the list as item #2.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist get 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Something

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist get 2
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Other thing

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist get 3
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Index out of range.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist delete -1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !mylist delete <num>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist delete 0
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !mylist delete <num>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist remove 3
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !mylist remove <num>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist remove what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !mylist remove <num>


handle hortbot user2/2 foobar/1 access=admin :!#foobar/mylist delete 1
send hortbot #user2 [HB] Cross-channel commands may not modify lists.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist remove 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "Something" has been removed.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist get 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Other thing

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist remove 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "Other thing" has been removed.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist get 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] The list is empty.


handle hortbot foobar/1 user2/2 access=subscriber :!mylist add Something
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 user2/2 access=subscriber :!mylist remove 1
no_send


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist add (_OOPS
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "(_OOPS" has been added to the list as item #1. Warning: item contains stray (_ or _) separators and may not be processed correctly.
